name: 70501 · Lafayette, LA
findings: ZIP 70501 (Lafayette) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70501 (Lafayette) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70501 (Lafayette) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
